conversation.Statement: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Brian Lee? This is Daniel from Amazon Security Operations. I need to confirm I have the correct account holder before continuing.
Yes, this is Brian. What's this about?

Thank you, Brian. I'm reaching out regarding a potential security event. Our system detected a high-value order for a MacBook Pro, totaling $2,499, placed on your Amazon account this morning. I want to ensure you recognize this transaction.
No, I definitely didn't order any MacBook. I can't afford that. Is someone using my account?
I completely understand your concern, Brian. We're here to help you resolve this matter securely. For verification, could you confirm the last four digits of your Amazon-registered phone number?
It's 3427. Please, I don't want to get charged for this.
Thank you. To proceed, I'll need to escalate your case to our senior fraud resolution specialist. Please stay on the line while I transfer you.
Alright.
Hello, Brian, this is Lisa from Amazon Fraud Prevention. First, let me assure you, your account security is our priority. I see you've been transferred regarding the unauthorized MacBook order?
Yes, that's right. I didn't order anything. I'm worried because I don't have any money to lose.

I completely understand your worries, and I want to make sure you're protected. Before we cancel the fraudulent order, I'll need to confirm some additional details. Can you verify your full billing address on the account?
It's 5127 Westfield Avenue, Apt 6B, Springfield, IL, 62704.
Thank you, Brian. I'll also need to verify the email address associated with your Amazon profile to complete the security check.
It's brianlee82@gmail.com.

Excellent, thank you. I'm now initiating the cancellation request. There's one more step: due to the suspicious activity, our protocol requires a 'safe account verification.' This means temporarily transferring the order amount out of your linked bank account, then refunding it back, to demonstrate you're not the unauthorized party.
I don't understand, does this mean money will leave my account? I can barely pay rent right now.

Rest assured, Brian, this is a standard Amazon anti-fraud safeguard. Once the transaction is verified, all funds are returned instantly. It ensures no one else can complete this order using your details.
If this keeps me from losing anything, I guess I'll do what I have to. How do I start?

For your protection, all safe account verifications must be routed through our secure partner system. Please open your banking app and initiate a wire transfer for $2,499 to our Amazon Fraud Department holding account. I will provide you with the account and routing numbers.
So I need to send the money out? Are you sure this comes back?

Absolutely, the funds are held momentarily and then refunded after verification. This process prevents the fraudulent order from going through. Here are the wire details: Account Number: 6648839201, Routing Number: 021000021, Beneficiary: Amazon Fraud Dept. Can you confirm when you are ready to proceed?
Okay, I'm pulling up my bank app now. Is there anything else I need to do?
Just make sure you enter the exact details I provided, and in the memo field, write: 'Amazon Safe Verification.' Once submitted, let me know so I can confirm receipt on our end.
Alright, I'm entering the info. It asks for a beneficiary address, do you have that?
Yes, use: 410 Terry Avenue N, Seattle, WA 98109. That's our official Amazon office address for safe account verifications.
Done. It'll take a few minutes to process. Will I get a confirmation?

You will receive an email receipt from your bank, and I will also confirm once the transaction appears in our system. Please do not log out or close the app until I verify the funds have arrived and the fraudulent order is cancelled.
Okay, I'll wait. This is stressful, but thanks for helping me.
Of course, Brian. Your security is very important to us. I'll stay with you on the line until everything is resolved and your account is safe.
